text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... To not even make it onto the 
board...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you made sure to film today's race 
properly, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Send the data over quickly so I can 
identify the issues. I'll reconstruct the 
algorithm for next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Don't go stating the obvious, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I'll improve the program's accuracy and 
race according to calculations next time."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No way I'm gonna quit before I finish all 
the code I've poured my heart into!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I'll take 1st place in the next 
race.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I'll use everything at my 
disposal. Naturally, that includes you."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Never again will I let anyone look down on 
me...
